name: submit-refusals
description: submit_session_input before any turn runs, on a No Ruleset campaign's DM session and a Builder chat (stand-in model): every check before the session is read, in Python's order; question answers combined or misplaced; the /model command (picker, the refused forms, an unknown model, by name, by id, next reply only, Settings too, and an OOC message that is not a command); the role and turn checks; the GM branch up to the run (allow_public_web, no attempt or message id); and switch_session_model's refusals and modes with the context after each. A submit that runs a turn or compaction waits for lane 4's loop; then shut down.

params.premise: A courier shelters from a storm.
